verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online's own docs say it connects to bank and credit-card accounts and imports transactions automatically. That covers the core of the story. The evidence does not establish a recurring daily import schedule; 'import your transactions for you' could mean an automatic feed, but no cadence is documented. Missing for 10: a documented daily or recurring import cadence, details on the bank-feed connection process and supported institutions, and independent or hands-on confirmation that feeds sync reliably.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Connect QuickBooks to your bank, credit cards, PayPal, Square, and more1 and we’ll import your transactions for you.
